_meta.purpose: Provider-independent prompt serialization patterns; not a model catalog or capability table.
_meta.verification: Choose a pattern and exact markers only after inspecting the selected endpoint's current documented syntax or user-supplied verified input contract.
_meta.language: Preserve the requested prompt language; propose translation only when a verified tool constraint requires it.
_meta.parameters: Put duration, aspect, resolution, seed, negative_prompt and camera controls in API fields only when those exact fields are supported. Do not invent unsupported fields or assume audio/reference/edit support.

narrative.structure: A concise paragraph describing subject, visible state change, setting, camera and look.
narrative.example: A close-up of a white flower bud in soft side light. The petals open slowly from a closed bud to a half-open bloom while the camera remains fixed.
narrative.condition: The selected input accepts natural-language scene descriptions.

production-spec.structure: Separate subject anchors, scene/look, ordered action beats and supported references. Use timestamps or marker syntax only when documented for the endpoint.
production-spec.example: Subject: supplied character identity. Start: cup on table. Action: fingers close around handle, then lift. End: cup held steadily above table. Camera: fixed medium shot.
production-spec.condition: The selected input documents structured blocks, reference slots or time-addressed beats.

edit-command.structure: Name the requested edit, its target, and the properties to preserve; reference the confirmed source-media input separately.
edit-command.example: Replace only the background with a sunset sky; preserve the subject, foreground geometry and original motion.
edit-command.condition: The endpoint supports the exact requested edit and confirmed source input type.

interactive.structure: Describe the current scene state and one bounded steering change at a time.
interactive.example: Continue forward along the path with a level horizon; stop before the gate.
interactive.condition: The selected runtime explicitly supports interactive steering; this is not a batch clip-generation instruction.
